# Agrishield India

> Agrishield (operated by Srii Veerabhadreshwara Krushi Kendra) is an advanced agricultural e-commerce and crop protection advisory platform in India. We provide organic and certified crop protection solutions, wild animal deterrents, repellents, seeds, and fertilizers directly to farmers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://agrishield.in/): Official homepage featuring our top organic crop protection products, wild boar repellents, and solar alarm strobes.
- [Shop](https://agrishield.in/shop): Full product catalog of agricultural repellents, strobes, and organic farm defense systems.
- [About Us](https://agrishield.in/about): Learn about Srii Veerabhadreshwara Krushi Kendra and our mission to protect Indian crops.
- [Contact](https://agrishield.in/contact): Get direct agricultural advisory and customer support from our expert agronomists.
- [Blog & Advisory](https://agrishield.in/blog): Farming guides, pest control techniques, and organic crop defense articles.

## Featured Crop Protection Products

- [Organic Wild Boar Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-wild-boar-repellent): Certified organic repellent granules to protect agricultural crops from wild boars.
- [Organic Snake Repellent Powder](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-snake-repellent): Natural boundary line defense against venomous and non-venomous snakes.
- [Organic Rat, Squirrel & Rabbit Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-rat-squirrel-rabbit-repellent): Organic repellent for farmland protection against rats, squirrels, and rabbits.
- [Organic Snail Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-snail-repellent): Effective organic crop protection against snails in vegetable farms and gardens.
- [Organic Lizard Repellent Spray](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-lizard-repellent): Safe, organic lizard deterrent spray for homes, offices, and farm warehouses.
- [Organic Rat Repellent Spray](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-rat-repellent-spray): Long-lasting organic spray to protect vehicle engine bays, wiring, and storage from rodents.
- [BONDON-B All Animals & Birds Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-animal-and-bird-repellent): Multi-species all-in-one organic repellent against elephants, wild boars, peacocks, monkeys, bears, deer, and more.
- [Organic Monkey Repellent Nuts](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-monkey-repellent-nuts): Non-toxic taste aversion repellent to protect fruit orchards and plantations from monkeys.
- [Dr Mullu Specialty Crop Defender](https://agrishield.in/product/dr-mullu-organic-animal-repellent): Specialty bio-organic crop protection liquid for agricultural farmland.
- [Organic Insect & Ant Repellent](https://agrishield.in/product/organic-ant-and-insect-repellent): 100% eco-friendly repellent to protect crops from ants, caterpillars, aphids, and farmland insects.
